title: Classic Onion and Beef Stock Gravy
summary: Soft onion and a toasty brown roux, simmered with beef stock into a smooth, savoury pouring gravy.

ingredients.note: low-salt; contains celery in most brands

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Soften the onion
steps.text: Melt the butter in the saucepan over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for about 5 min until soft and translucent.

steps.title: Brown the roux
steps.text: Sprinkle over the flour and stir for 4-6 min until the mixture is a toasty golden brown. Turn the heat down if it colours too quickly; the colour gives the gravy its flavour.

steps.title: Whisk in the stock
steps.text: Add the hot stock a little at a time, whisking until smooth, then let it simmer for 8-10 min, stirring, until it coats a spoon.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Stir in any juices from your roast, season with salt and pepper, and pour into a warm jug. Serve with sliced roast chicken or beef and mashed potatoes.

tips: Heat the stock first; it blends into the roux with fewer lumps.
For a silky finish, strain out the onion before serving.
Add a splash of water if it thickens too much on standing.
Taste before salting, as stock strength varies.
storage: Cool and refrigerate for up to 3 days, or freeze for up to 3 months. Reheat until piping hot, whisking in a little water. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
